title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(山岸邦彰研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Yamagishi Kuniaki)
educationalGoal: The mission is to increase added value (building added value) in each aspect of building planning, design, construction, and operation, taking into account economic efficiency, productivity, regionality, functionality, and applicability. Under this mission, the project theme can be searched and selected based on the knowledge of the building structure, then the implementation plan, survey, analysis, development, etc. can be implemented based on the theme, and the obtained results are considered.
advice: ◆ Primary semester Acquisition of basic knowledge and setting of project (1) Learn basic knowledge about each activity area. (2) Receive guidance through seminars on whether the theme selected by each person is appropriate for Project Design (1) and complete the project proposal. (3) Investigate, analyze, develop, etc., according to each project proposal.発 表 Announce the results of the previous semester at an interim presentation in the seminar (at the seminar camp). ◆ Second semester Summary and report of project execution and results ①Compile the results of activities (survey, analysis, development, etc.) conducted in the previous semester. (2) Summarize the results of the entire project and submit it as a project report. (3) The contents of the project report will be announced at the public presentation examination committee (public hearing) for the project design of the architectural core (2). Check learning attitudes, activities in seminars, contributions, etc. through conventional wisdom and reflect them in grades. You must not uselessly be late or absent, provided that you observe the rules of a working adult. [Warning] To obtain credits, attendance at seminars, etc. should be 2/3 or more, instruction time should be 90 hours or more, activity time should be 410 hours or more, achievement should be 60% or more. Must be presented and passed at the Interim Jury and the Public presentation examination committee. If the interim examination fails, it is not possible to enter the public presentation examination committee.
requiredKnowledge: The following subjects are recommended; Architectural integrated exercise A and B, Structural mechanics for architecture I and II, Reinforced concrete structures, Steel structures, Architectural Safety Engineering, Structure planning for architecture, Building materials.

activityGoals.body: Students can graps social affairs and industry trends, extract their essence, and discover any problems.
Students can make plans and conduct necessary surveys, experiments, and analyzes on themes you have set.
Students can compile the results obtained from investigations, experiments, and analyzes into project reports.
Students will be able to logically present the contents of their project report.
Students can identify and explore their own career path, and move in a direction they will not regret.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students understand the background of the socio-economic situation, the building market, etc., select themes that add value to local communities, end users, general companies, etc., make a project implementation plan, and conduct surveys, analysis, Develop and, finally, give presentations on activity results under the guidance of the instructor. In addition, these results can be published in newspapers, academic societies, etc., joint research with other organizations can be performed, and patentable technology development can be planned and invented.
achievementLevels.standard: Students understand the background of the socio-economic situation, the construction market, etc., select a suitable theme as the project theme (including the case where the instructor designates the theme), make a project implementation plan, and conduct surveys and analysis necessary for the execution of the theme ・ Development and, finally, presentation of activity results can be conducted under the guidance of the instructor.
